description: Build and measure a .NET text inference server with original Metal kernels for the official Qwen3.8-27B FP8 checkpoint on Apple M5 Pro. Preserve the checkpoint's E4M3 weights and block scales; decode operands inside kernels without affine requantization. First establish correct model execution, then profile batching, matrix operations, attention and DeltaNet preparation. Qwen3.6 optimization reports and Splash community-checkpoint measurements are prior external evidence only, not controlled measurements or results of this experiment.
target_weights: Official fine-grained FP8 E4M3 weights with 128x128 BF16 block scales; non-quantized checkpoint tensors preserved
